A '''carrot''' is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Night Vision}}. Eaten raw, it heals {{Hp|1}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/carrot.json}}</ref> It is the ingredient of [[steamed carrots]], [[pickled carrots]], [[carrot cupcake]]s, [[Pad Thai]] and [[lumpia]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Farming ===
Carrot crops drop the pack's carrots, with Fortune and the Electrum tool intrinsic each adding extra carrots when fully grown.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/carrots.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a carrot heals {{Hp|1}}.

Picking up a carrot unlocks steamed carrots, pickled carrots, carrot cupcakes and Pad Thai. Carrots are also used in [[golden carrot]]s, [[gimmari]], [[bokguk]], [[seitan]], [[curry stock]] and [[pumpkin curry stock]].
